en.text: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 比撒列用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线做精致的衣服，在圣所用以供职，又为亚伦做圣衣，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 比撒列用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線做精緻的衣服，在聖所用以供職，又為亞倫做聖衣，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

en.text: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

zhSimplified.text: 他用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做以弗得；

zhTraditional.text: 他用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做以弗得；

en.text: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

zhSimplified.text: 把金子锤成薄片，剪出线来，与蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，用巧匠的手工一同绣上。

zhTraditional.text: 把金子錘成薄片，剪出線來，與藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，用巧匠的手工一同繡上。

en.text: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

zhSimplified.text: 又为以弗得做两条相连的肩带，接连在以弗得的两头。

zhTraditional.text: 又為以弗得做兩條相連的肩帶，接連在以弗得的兩頭。

en.text: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 其上巧工织的带子和以弗得一样的做法，用以束上，与以弗得接连一块，是用金线和蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做的，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 其上巧工織的帶子和以弗得一樣的做法，用以束上，與以弗得接連一塊，是用金線和藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做的，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

en.text: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 又琢出两块红玛瑙，镶在金槽上，仿佛刻图书，按着以色列儿子的名字雕刻；

zhTraditional.text: 又琢出兩塊紅瑪瑙，鑲在金槽上，彷彿刻圖書，按着以色列兒子的名字雕刻；

en.text: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 将这两块宝石安在以弗得的两条肩带上，为以色列人做纪念石，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。 （出28·15—30）

zhTraditional.text: 將這兩塊寶石安在以弗得的兩條肩帶上，為以色列人做紀念石，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。 （出28‧15－30）

en.text: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

zhSimplified.text: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一样的做法，用金线与蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做的。

zhTraditional.text: 他用巧匠的手工做胸牌，和以弗得一樣的做法，用金線與藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做的。

en.text: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

footnotes.text: 39:9 A span is the length from the tip of a man’s thumb to the tip of his little finger when his hand is stretched out (about half a cubit, or 9 inches, or 22.8 cm.)

zhSimplified.text: 胸牌是四方的，叠为两层；这两层长一虎口，宽一虎口，

zhTraditional.text: 胸牌是四方的，疊為兩層；這兩層長一虎口，寬一虎口，

en.text: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

zhSimplified.text: 上面镶着宝石四行：第一行是红宝石、红璧玺、红玉；

zhTraditional.text: 上面鑲着寶石四行：第一行是紅寶石、紅璧璽、紅玉；

en.text: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

zhSimplified.text: 第二行是绿宝石、蓝宝石、金钢石；

zhTraditional.text: 第二行是綠寶石、藍寶石、金鋼石；

en.text: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

zhSimplified.text: 第三行是紫玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；

zhTraditional.text: 第三行是紫瑪瑙、白瑪瑙、紫晶；

en.text: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

zhSimplified.text: 第四行是水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉。这都镶在金槽中。

zhTraditional.text: 第四行是水蒼玉、紅瑪瑙、碧玉。這都鑲在金槽中。

en.text: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

zhSimplified.text: 这些宝石都是按着以色列十二个儿子的名字，仿佛刻图书，刻十二个支派的名字。

zhTraditional.text: 這些寶石都是按着以色列十二個兒子的名字，彷彿刻圖書，刻十二個支派的名字。

en.text: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

zhSimplified.text: 在胸牌上，用精金拧成如绳子的链子。

zhTraditional.text: 在胸牌上，用精金擰成如繩子的鍊子。

en.text: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

zhSimplified.text: 又做两个金槽和两个金环，安在胸牌的两头。

zhTraditional.text: 又做兩個金槽和兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭。

en.text: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

zhSimplified.text: 把那两条拧成的金链子穿过胸牌两头的环子，

zhTraditional.text: 把那兩條擰成的金鍊子穿過胸牌兩頭的環子，

en.text: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

zhSimplified.text: 又把链子的那两头接在两槽上，安在以弗得前面肩带上。

zhTraditional.text: 又把鍊子的那兩頭接在兩槽上，安在以弗得前面肩帶上。

en.text: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

zhSimplified.text: 做两个金环，安在胸牌的两头，在以弗得里面的边上，

zhTraditional.text: 做兩個金環，安在胸牌的兩頭，在以弗得裏面的邊上，

en.text: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

zhSimplified.text: 又做两个金环，安在以弗得前面两条肩带的下边，挨近相接之处，在以弗得巧工织的带子以上。

zhTraditional.text: 又做兩個金環，安在以弗得前面兩條肩帶的下邊，挨近相接之處，在以弗得巧工織的帶子以上。

en.text: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 用一条蓝细带子把胸牌的环子和以弗得的环子系住，使胸牌贴在以弗得巧工织的带子上，不可与以弗得离缝，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。 （出28·31—43）

zhTraditional.text: 用一條藍細帶子把胸牌的環子和以弗得的環子繫住，使胸牌貼在以弗得巧工織的帶子上，不可與以弗得離縫，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。 （出28‧31－43）

en.text: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

zhSimplified.text: 他用织工做以弗得的外袍，颜色全是蓝的。

zhTraditional.text: 他用織工做以弗得的外袍，顏色全是藍的。

en.text: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

zhSimplified.text: 袍上留一领口，口的周围织出领边来，仿佛铠甲的领口，免得破裂。

zhTraditional.text: 袍上留一領口，口的周圍織出領邊來，彷彿鎧甲的領口，免得破裂。

en.text: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

zhSimplified.text: 在袍子底边上，用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻做石榴，

zhTraditional.text: 在袍子底邊上，用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻做石榴，

en.text: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

zhSimplified.text: 又用精金做铃铛，把铃铛钉在袍子周围底边上的石榴中间：

zhTraditional.text: 又用精金做鈴鐺，把鈴鐺釘在袍子周圍底邊上的石榴中間：

en.text: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 一个铃铛一个石榴，一个铃铛一个石榴，在袍子周围底边上用以供职，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 一個鈴鐺一個石榴，一個鈴鐺一個石榴，在袍子周圍底邊上用以供職，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

en.text: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

zhSimplified.text: 他用织成的细麻布为亚伦和他的儿子做内袍，

zhTraditional.text: 他用織成的細麻布為亞倫和他的兒子做內袍，

en.text: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

zhSimplified.text: 并用细麻布做冠冕和华美的裹头巾，用捻的细麻布做裤子，

zhTraditional.text: 並用細麻布做冠冕和華美的裹頭巾，用撚的細麻布做褲子，

en.text: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 又用蓝色、紫色、朱红色线，并捻的细麻，以绣花的手工做腰带，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 又用藍色、紫色、朱紅色線，並撚的細麻，以繡花的手工做腰帶，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

en.text: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.

zhSimplified.text: 他用精金做圣冠上的牌，在上面按刻图书之法，刻着「归耶和华为圣」。

zhTraditional.text: 他用精金做聖冠上的牌，在上面按刻圖書之法，刻着「歸耶和華為聖」。

en.text: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 又用一条蓝细带子将牌系在冠冕上，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。 （出35·10—19）

zhTraditional.text: 又用一條藍細帶子將牌繫在冠冕上，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。 （出35‧10－19）

en.text: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.

zhSimplified.text: 帐幕，就是会幕，一切的工就这样做完了。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照样做了。

zhTraditional.text: 帳幕，就是會幕，一切的工就這樣做完了。凡耶和華所吩咐摩西的，以色列人都照樣做了。

en.text: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

zhSimplified.text: 他们送到摩西那里。帐幕和帐幕的一切器具，就是钩子、板、闩、柱子、带卯的座，

zhTraditional.text: 他們送到摩西那裏。帳幕和帳幕的一切器具，就是鉤子、板、閂、柱子、帶卯的座，

en.text: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

zhSimplified.text: 染红公羊皮的盖、海狗皮的顶盖，和遮掩柜的幔子，

zhTraditional.text: 染紅公羊皮的蓋、海狗皮的頂蓋，和遮掩櫃的幔子，

en.text: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

zhSimplified.text: 法柜和柜的杠并施恩座，

zhTraditional.text: 法櫃和櫃的槓並施恩座，

en.text: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

zhSimplified.text: 桌子和桌子的一切器具并陈设饼，

zhTraditional.text: 桌子和桌子的一切器具並陳設餅，

en.text: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

zhSimplified.text: 精金的灯台和摆列的灯盏，与灯台的一切器具，并点灯的油，

zhTraditional.text: 精金的燈臺和擺列的燈盞，與燈臺的一切器具，並點燈的油，

en.text: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

zhSimplified.text: 金坛、膏油、馨香的香料、会幕的门帘，

zhTraditional.text: 金壇、膏油、馨香的香料、會幕的門簾，

en.text: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

zhSimplified.text: 铜坛和坛上的铜网，坛的杠并坛的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，

zhTraditional.text: 銅壇和壇上的銅網，壇的槓並壇的一切器具，洗濯盆和盆座，

en.text: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

zhSimplified.text: 院子的帷子和柱子，并带卯的座，院子的门帘、绳子、橛子，并帐幕和会幕中一切使用的器具，

zhTraditional.text: 院子的帷子和柱子，並帶卯的座，院子的門簾、繩子、橛子，並帳幕和會幕中一切使用的器具，

en.text: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

zhSimplified.text: 精工做的礼服，和祭司亚伦并他儿子在圣所用以供祭司职分的圣衣。

zhTraditional.text: 精工做的禮服，和祭司亞倫並他兒子在聖所用以供祭司職分的聖衣。

en.text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

zhSimplified.text: 这一切工作都是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐摩西做的。

zhTraditional.text: 這一切工作都是以色列人照耶和華所吩咐摩西做的。

en.text: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华怎样吩咐的，他们就怎样做了。摩西看见一切的工都做成了，就给他们祝福。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華怎樣吩咐的，他們就怎樣做了。摩西看見一切的工都做成了，就給他們祝福。
